purpose: Classify a seat's own host-supplied capacity headroom and recommend timely compaction or handoff without acting.
procedure: Request bounded fill-level signals for the invoking seat from an injected host adapter.
Refuse cross-seat, missing, invalid, or over-budget readings as UNKNOWN.
Compute the minimum declared headroom and classify AMPLE, TIGHTENING, or NEAR_LIMIT.
Recommend continue, compact soon, or seal handoff now.
Seal the reading and take no direct action.
rules: UNKNOWN is preferred to a plausible guess.
Every use emits a typed receipt and releases raw material.
boundaries: No context content inspection or summarization.
No estimation of another seat's capacity.
No hardware-body substitution for cognitive capacity.
No automatic compaction, truncation, or handoff.
Missing host metrics remain an explicit UNKNOWN hold.

retention.law: EPHEMERAL BY DEFAULT. Raw sense material is released at the next step. Only a bounded typed receipt survives.
retention.released_when: before the typed observation is returned
retention.accumulation_across_uses: flat and zero after every release boundary
retention.deletion_scope: only material created by the exact sense use, by exact id or path; never a wildcard or recursive sweep
